facts.text: Order the strawberries, Edward. They go with the champagne, and I've earned a night off.
facts.why: Vivian doesn't say this. It is printed in quote marks, and in the film Edward is the one who orders the strawberries and champagne. Her real lines include 'Baby, I'm gonna treat you so nice, you're never gonna wanna let me go.'
facts.fix: Baby, I'm gonna treat you so nice, you're never gonna wanna let me go.

facts.text: ordering everything off the room service menu
facts.why: It is Edward who orders everything on the menu for her breakfast, saying he took the liberty because he did not know what she would like.

vibe.verdict: The best of this batch. A room service hotel suits the film, and the strawberries and champagne, red dress and necklace box are all in.
